.gstudio/artifacts/artifact/scripts/crea.instruction: Run {{script}} <name> where <name> is the lowercase word naming the new artifact to scaffold.

.gstudio/artifacts/artifact/scripts/list.instruction: Run {{script}} [search-term] to list every artifact whose name or definition file path contains the optional search term, or all artifacts if omitted.

.gstudio/artifacts/artifact/scripts/upda.instruction: Run {{script}} <name> from the project root, where <name> is the artifact's id.

.gstudio/artifacts/artifact/scripts/dele.instruction: Run `{{script}} <name>`, where `<name>` is the artifact's name.
Run `{{script}} <name>` where `<name>` is the artifact name whose dangling references should be listed.

.gstudio/artifacts/artifact/scripts/eval.instruction: Run `{{script}} <name>` to evaluate whether the artifact named `<name>` complies with the rules and is fully compiled, printing any discrepancies to stdout and exiting 1, or printing a success message and exiting 0 when it complies.

create.text: Scaffolds a new artifact instance given its name and description, exiting 1 if the definition file already exists.

list.text: Lists artifact definitions in the codebase, optionally filtered by a search term, and prints each match as its artifact name and file path.

update.text: Applies a natural-language change request to an existing artifact definition file, given the artifact name and the change request, exiting 1 if it does not exist.

delete.text: Deletes an artifact definition, its compiled scripts and skills, given the artifact name, and removes dangling references to it from the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that an artifact's definition file, parsing, action ordering, and compiled outputs match the compiler's expectations, given the artifact name as input.
